authority: Geometry references support display mechanics. Project applicability and safeguards are engineering guidance subordinate to unchanged project and EDA Rules; no new methods, statistics or source access are authorized.
selection_instructions: Choose a small set of complementary displays from the objective, data level and supplied fields. This catalog is not a required checklist.
Assess visualization separately from modeling, linkage or pooling limits. Restrictions on one operation do not automatically exclude all descriptive views.
Match the intended display to the exact implemented_r_operations registry. For unavailable functions retain a specific DEFERRED display plan and an explicitly justified source-table fallback.

Specify source dataset/columns, units, experimental unit, grouping, statuses, scale, limitations and EC preparation using existing analysis/display_spec/execution fields. Method IDs may label display_spec.kind; they are not evidence/source IDs or reference_sections.
Statistics belong to an authorized EC operation. EV must not silently calculate renderer-default counts, quantiles, smoothing, normalization or inferential intervals.
Library size does not imply producing every chart. Do not add agent calls, automatic replanning or repeated extraction.

shared_options.guidance: Split by study, species, matrix, regimen or endpoint when relevant. Preserve source separation and disclose free versus fixed axes; a facet is not permission to pool.

Choose linear or log display only when informative. Log coordinates require positive supported values. Already-log10 CFU responses remain on their reported scale; do not apply a second log transform or automatically generate duplicate linear/log figures.

A reversible display reshape may retain original column names and cell references without creating animal identities. Unconnected points may remain possible when trajectories are not. Reshaping still requires a registered EC/EV implementation.
Use transparency, symbol size, panels or deterministic categorical jitter. Do not jitter measured time/concentration coordinates silently; retain original coordinates.
Use explicit categories or known-bound symbols. Preserve BLQ, not sampled, absent, unknown and censored distinctions. Unknown numeric limits belong in annotations/status strips.
Label SD, SEM, CI, range and digitization tolerance distinctly. Do not create missing uncertainty or convert types without sufficient data and authorization.
Identify the concrete affected rows or series and the limited interpretation. Notes do not legitimize a misleading graphic. Keep the source table and row/point mapping.

Raincloud-style raw points plus distribution summary, small multiples and overlays are compositions of these methods, not separate mandatory figures. Every layer must independently satisfy its conditions.

methods.name: Numeric scatter
methods.question: Inspect two measured quantities without fitting.
methods.required_inputs: Numeric x/y from the same supported observation; units and record IDs.
methods.applicability: Keep study, matrix and experimental-unit scope explicit.
methods.limitations: No invented joins, smoothing, regression or cross-study pooling.
methods.ec_preparation: None for source-native coordinates.

methods.name: Time-response points
methods.question: Inspect PK or time-kill observations over time.
methods.required_inputs: Recorded time, response, time origin, dose-event context and series identity.
methods.applicability: Show source-defined series separately; alternative time coordinates need labeled separate views.
methods.limitations: Missing identity prevents individual trajectories, not unconnected points. No interpolated observations.
methods.ec_preparation: None for source-native coordinates.

methods.name: Categorical strip / jitter plot
methods.question: Compare observed terminal responses across experimental groups.
methods.required_inputs: Group labels, raw responses, units and experimental-unit level.
methods.applicability: Retain individual points; deterministic horizontal jitter may reveal overlap.
methods.limitations: Jitter is display-only, not a measured coordinate. Do not turn source means into individuals.
methods.ec_preparation: Explicit group layout and reversible display offsets.

methods.name: Connected series / trajectory
methods.question: Follow an established ordered series.
methods.required_inputs: Ordered coordinates and verified series or subject identity.
methods.applicability: Distinguish individual trajectories from source-reported mean series.
methods.limitations: No identity inferred from repeated column labels. Break lines at unsupported gaps; no fitted trajectory claim.
methods.ec_preparation: Validate order, identity and permitted segment boundaries.

methods.name: Summary point with error bars
methods.question: Display reported center and uncertainty or spread.
methods.required_inputs: Center plus SD, SEM or stated lower/upper bounds, their type, units and available n.
methods.applicability: Label exactly which interval type is reported; use asymmetric endpoints when supplied.
methods.limitations: Do not interchange SD, SEM and CI or manufacture missing intervals. No new inferential CI.
methods.ec_preparation: Use supplied endpoints or explicitly authorized arithmetic; retain origin and interval type.

methods.name: Boxplot with source points
methods.question: Inspect group distributions without fitting.
methods.required_inputs: Individual values or an explicitly defined source five-number summary.
methods.applicability: State quantile and whisker conventions; show n and original points when available.
methods.limitations: Mean/SD alone cannot reconstruct a boxplot. Marked extremes are not automatically errors.
methods.ec_preparation: Quantiles and whiskers require an authorized, implemented EC operation; otherwise use supplied summaries.

methods.name: Violin with source points
methods.question: Compare distribution shapes.
methods.required_inputs: Raw comparable observations, grouping and experimental-unit metadata.
methods.applicability: Specify density bandwidth and support; retain observations and group sizes.
methods.limitations: Sparse groups may not support a useful density view. Do not reconstruct a density from mean/SD or treat repeated observations as independent animals.
methods.ec_preparation: Explicit approved density calculation; no renderer-default statistical transformation.

methods.name: Histogram / frequency polygon
methods.question: Inspect observed frequency across value bins.
methods.required_inputs: Numeric observations or exact source-reported bins and counts.
methods.applicability: Show bin boundaries and counts; distinguish count from density.
methods.limitations: Retain censored/open-ended bins; do not replace them with invented midpoints.
methods.ec_preparation: Explicit authorized binning/counts, or use exact supplied frequency summaries.

methods.name: Empirical cumulative distribution
methods.question: Display the observed cumulative distribution.
methods.required_inputs: Raw values, observation unit and denominator.
methods.applicability: State the sample scope; separate studies and data levels.
methods.limitations: Ordinary ECDF does not resolve censoring. Do not claim population representativeness or inferential bands.
methods.ec_preparation: Authorized sorting and cumulative counting; special censoring estimators are outside this card.

methods.name: Density curve
methods.question: Explore continuous distribution shape.
methods.required_inputs: Comparable raw values, bandwidth, support and unit of observation.
methods.applicability: Declare smoothing choices and retain a view of observed values.
methods.limitations: Not a fitted PK model; do not smooth across incompatible groups, censoring or missing values.
methods.ec_preparation: Explicit authorized kernel-density calculation.

methods.name: Frequency bar / lollipop
methods.question: Compare observed category frequencies, including MIC bins.
methods.required_inputs: Named categories with exact counts or countable records.
methods.applicability: State what one counted unit represents; show complete relevant categories.
methods.limitations: A reported mean is not a frequency. Preserve open-ended MIC-bin labels.
methods.ec_preparation: Authorized counting or use supplied counts.

methods.name: Grouped / stacked proportion bars
methods.question: Compare category composition with a known denominator.
methods.required_inputs: Category counts or supplied proportions, denominator and population definition.
methods.applicability: Show denominator and missing/unknown category separately; label percentage units.
methods.limitations: Do not silently renormalize incomplete totals or imply PTA weights are valid.
methods.ec_preparation: Authorized proportions only; retain source totals and rounding discrepancies.

methods.name: Numeric heatmap
methods.question: Inspect a matrix of measured or reported values.
methods.required_inputs: Explicit row/column keys, numeric values, units and data level.
methods.applicability: Use comparable scales; separate incompatible units and matrices.
methods.limitations: No silent imputation, z-scoring, clustering or invented grid cells.
methods.ec_preparation: Source layout; any normalization or aggregation needs separate authorization and implementation.

methods.name: Missingness / observation-status matrix
methods.question: Locate patterns of available, missing and censored observations.
methods.required_inputs: Record/field keys and explicit value-status codes.
methods.applicability: Distinguish not sampled, BLQ, censored, unknown and absent values.
methods.limitations: A blank cell is not automatically a missing scheduled sample; preserve unknown design.
methods.ec_preparation: Reshape existing status labels; do not reassess Data coverage.

methods.name: Status-count chart
methods.question: Summarize which observations carry each recorded status.
methods.required_inputs: Existing statuses and scoped observation counts.
methods.applicability: Use an explicit denominator and distinguish record counts from animal counts.
methods.limitations: Not a new adequacy verdict; unknown status is not zero or quantified.
methods.ec_preparation: Authorized status counting or supplied counts.

methods.name: Paired-change / slope / dumbbell
methods.question: Compare two supported measurements within a defined pair.
methods.required_inputs: Verified pair key, two conditions, values and comparable units.
methods.applicability: Separate individual pairs from paired reported group summaries.
methods.limitations: No pairing by row order, similar labels or guessed animal identity.
methods.ec_preparation: Validate pairing; differences only if separately allowed.

methods.name: Interval / censor-limit display
methods.question: Show a supported observation bound without inventing its value.
methods.required_inputs: Known bound(s), censor direction, units and record identity.
methods.applicability: Use directional markers at known limits; label as bounds, not observed concentrations.
methods.limitations: Unknown limits/direction belong in a status strip or note, not an invented y coordinate.
methods.ec_preparation: Resolve only supplied bounds and statuses; no substitution or imputation.

methods.name: Reported-estimate interval / forest-style
methods.question: Compare already-reported estimates and intervals.
methods.required_inputs: Labeled source estimates with interval type, endpoints, units and population.
methods.applicability: Preserve study and endpoint differences; show source definitions.
methods.limitations: No pooled estimate, meta-analysis, new CI, efficacy inference or unsupported ranking.
methods.ec_preparation: Use supplied estimates and interval endpoints only.

methods.name: Bubble plot
methods.question: Show a measured third quantity alongside x/y.
methods.required_inputs: Supported paired x/y and a nonnegative size quantity with units.
methods.applicability: Map size to a documented area scale; identify zeros visibly.
methods.limitations: No fabricated weights, extrapolated values or implied sample size.
methods.ec_preparation: Explicit source-to-area display mapping.

methods.name: Scatterplot matrix
methods.question: Inspect several jointly observed quantities.
methods.required_inputs: Verified shared experimental units and numeric columns with units.
methods.applicability: Select variables relevant to an allowed descriptive question; disclose pairwise missingness.
methods.limitations: No joining independent series; no automatic correlation testing, covariate analysis or model selection.
methods.ec_preparation: Supported pairing/layout only; derived correlations need separate scope authorization.

methods.name: Dosing / sampling event timeline
methods.question: Show the supplied regimen and sampling design.
methods.required_inputs: Explicit event times, time origin, event type, route and known duration.
methods.applicability: Distinguish scheduled events from actual administration/sampling; retain dose basis.
methods.limitations: Do not infer administered doses from a schedule or expand unresolved regimen intervals.
methods.ec_preparation: Render supplied events; schedule expansion or time conversion requires explicit supported inputs and authorization.

execution_authorization: The current task_context.implemented_r_operations registry and exact signatures govern execution; a candidate link is not an execution grant.

reference_defaults.supports: Geometry and statistical-transform behavior; not PK/PD applicability or project authorization.
